assertions.description: 前提：真车载端报 overallOutcome=UNKNOWN，服务端判装载 RecoveryRequired、旅程 Blocked

assertions.expected: Opened / RESUME_AFTER_REPAIR→RecoveryActionRejected(PROVEN_RECOVERY_CHECKPOINT_REQUIRED) / 会话行 1：OPEN、无动作、r1 / 工作流 0
